notes.title: A working prototype walks into a bar...
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45187942/01420ce3453bf4c1ce66a89065be1879c5fe3c6e.png"][/img][/p][p]After just over a year, today, I uploaded the first 'working' full completable version of Brownie's Adventure: The Final resolution. What a year it's been...

With three months to go, I am feeling quietly confident in making the December deadline!

So many evenings hunched over chuckling away and dreaming up puzzles and humorous situations. So many Imrans kebabs ordered. All for the greater good... the show must go on!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45187942/809bae7b05b216529602f3aa350e54a56399022f.png"][/img][/p][p]Oh yeah... after (more than one) requests... Sausage Roland is back in the game. Literally.

Here's to some bug squashing, a Friday night and the saving of the North Derbyshire and South Yorkshire area. 

Love you bye x[/p]
